payload.title: Reconcile official static-check scopes and isolate Ruff diagnostic renderer panic
payload.summary: Independently reproduced developer tooling failure with installed pinned Ruff0.16.2: ruff format --check experiments/codex_dogfood/case_0016/adjudication/primary/stage_c_builder.py panics in ruff_annotate_snippets source_map.rs:185, annotation0..36669 beyond buffer36667. --quiet also panics. The file is a frozen historical builder, not supported production source. Official development docs show broad Ruff commands with no retained-tree Ruff exclusion, while strict mypy and protected pytest have explicit experiment exclusions; prior broad lint24631 findings and28 supported format discrepancies are not green checks.
payload.benefit: Decide and document supported source versus immutable artifact static-check ownership. Preserve frozen bytes and production branch gate. Isolate a minimal non-sensitive diagnostic reproducer if appropriate; qualify a locked tool upgrade or scoped invocation in an explicitly approved follow-up, with wrong-scope/error-code regressions. Acceptance: supported checks cover all supported owners and return accurate statuses; retained verification remains explicit; known builder does not cause an unexplained overall gate panic;28 existing supported formatting differences receive reviewed disposition without mass-formatting scientific artifacts. No external issue submission/install/lock change authorized by research.
payload.uncertainty: External tool diagnostic crash, not a demonstrated RI algorithm defect. Supported-only checks previously complete; broad scope failure remains real. Needs maintainer scope decision before configuration/dependency changes. No duplicate existing narrowly matching tooling proposal found; B-0047 covers pytest isolation, not formatter/lint policy.
